howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB. Best for batch-style documents: monthly statements, multi-invoice exports, chapter-divided manuscripts.

howto.name: Enter the search phrase
howto.text: Type the keyword that appears at the start of each section (e.g. 'Invoice #', 'Statement of', 'Chapter').

howto.name: Toggle case sensitivity
howto.text: Enable case-sensitive matching if your keyword's capitalization matters.

howto.name: Split and download
howto.text: Click Split. Every page containing the keyword starts a new chunk. The result is a ZIP of part1.pdf, part2.pdf, etc.

faq.q: How does it decide where to split?
faq.a: It scans every page for your search term. Every page that contains the term becomes the start of a new chunk. The chunk runs until the next match-page or the end of the document.
Not in the current version — the search is a literal string match (case-sensitive optional). For regex splits, use the dev API directly.

faq.q: What if my keyword doesn't appear at all?
faq.a: The tool returns a 400 error with a clear message. Make sure your search exactly matches the casing if you have case-sensitive enabled.
